python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo

v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5, 'rc.1', 'build.9')
print('Original:', v)
print('bump_major():', v.bump_major())
print('bump_minor():', v.bump_minor())
print('bump_patch():', v.bump_patch())
print('bump_prerelease():', v.bump_prerelease())
print('bump_build():', v.bump_build())

# Test immutability is preserved
print('Original after bumps:', v)

# Test chaining
print('Chained:', VersionInfo(1, 2, 3).bump_major().bump_minor())
"
